t: Quantum Dot Cellular Automata Systems Simulator
title: Quantum Dot Cellular Automata Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Quantum Dot Cellular Automata operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Quantum Dot Cellular Automata installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 24589 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where dot cells monitoring, automata logistics redundancy, or clocking zones maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Quantum Dot Cellular Automata Master Roadmap
title: Quantum Dot Cellular Automata Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Quantum Dot Cellular Automata: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Quantum Dot Cellular Automata — logic from interacting quantum-dot cells.

Phase 1 — Prove (dot cells): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (automata logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (clocking zones): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (room-temp goals): automata hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and labs-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
